Homemade Playdough
By: Kitch-N-Chik
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 2:11pm

Ingredients




1 cup Flour
1 cup Water
1 cup Salt
2 tablespoons Cream of tartar
1 tablespoon Oil

Preparation

1 Cook this stuff until it forms a mess, excuse me, mass in the pan. Turn it out on a plate, pick an old one, and cover it with a damp cloth, also and old one. Food coloring may be added. Store playdough in the refrigerator but do me a favor......don't EAT the stuff.
